span.p:
Symptoms:
- Eviction rate = write rate (every write = eviction)
- Hit ratio under 20%
- Database CPU at 90%+
- Response time degradation (10x+)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Solutions:
- Increase cache size
- Reduce write rate to cache
- Switch to scan-resistant policy
- Add TTL to reduce eviction pressure
